meta.title: Additive composition of persona feature vectors: staged paths for every feature order
meta.model_config: mean residual-stream activation per persona condition at language_29_D5120; compound personas are gender x emotion x country

feature_labels.id: persona key <gender>_<emotion>_extended_<country>, as saved; the emotion key 'sad' is labelled 'sadness'

units.*_display, display, display_delta: coordinates in the shared 3D PCA basis, in activation units
units.full_space_norm, *_distance_*, *_journey: Euclidean norm in the full activation space, activation units
units.*_cosine_to_observed: cosine in the full activation space, -1 to 1 (see composition_convention.cosine_definition)
units.coefficient: multiplier applied to the raw feature vector

meta.aggregation: one entry per compound condition and per ordered non-empty subset of (gender, emotion, country); 'aggregate' holds means over the 32 conditions and reproduces the Stage 3 result of results/EX1_T2_additivity.ipynb
caveats: This export visualises representational geometry and approximate additivity only. It is not a causal-control result: nothing here was obtained by intervening on the model.
Display coordinates are a 3D projection; cosines, distances and norms are computed in the full 5120-dimensional space and are the values to quote.
The feature vectors are averages over the same conditions they are used to predict (in-sample), so agreement is an upper bound on transfer to unseen conditions.

Partial feature sets are compared with the fully specified observed persona, so their cosines and distances describe how much of the gap that subset closes, not a prediction of a matching partial persona.
Condition means come from a single activation collection run on one model, prompt template and image sample.

projection.method: PCA fit on real observed condition means only
projection.fit_on: 48 observed persona-condition means (16 base, 16 Germany, 16 Nigeria); the grand mean, components and predictions are transformed afterwards and never enter the fit
projection.centering: mean of the fitted condition means is subtracted (standard PCA)
projection.solver: numpy.linalg.svd of the centred matrix (LAPACK, exact), full_matrices=False
projection.sign_convention: each component is oriented so that the fitted condition with the largest absolute score on it has a positive score
projection.components: not published (three 5120-dimensional vectors); identified by projection_hash
projection.transform: positions: (h - fit mean) . components; displacements (display_delta): v . components. The map is affine, so a displayed path is the exact shadow of the full-space path

composition_convention.path: grand mean -> +-1/2 gender -> emotion -> country -> predicted compound persona
composition_convention.gender: signed half-gender vector: +1/2 v_gender for female, -1/2 v_gender for male
composition_convention.scaling: raw naturally scaled mean-difference vectors; no component is unit-normalised for the composition
composition_convention.order_invariance: vector addition commutes: the visiting order changes the intermediate stages, not the final point of a given feature set

feature_vectors.provenance: derived from the saved condition means by analytics/II1_persona_analytics/additivity.py::derive_raw_feature_vectors, the definition used in results/EX1_T2_additivity.ipynb

grand_mean.definition: mean of the 16 base persona-condition means

gender.definition: mean of the 8 female base condition means minus mean of the 8 male base condition means

anger.definition: mean of the base condition means with emotion anger (female and male) minus the grand mean

amusement.definition: mean of the base condition means with emotion amusement (female and male) minus the grand mean

awe.definition: mean of the base condition means with emotion awe (female and male) minus the grand mean

contentment.definition: mean of the base condition means with emotion contentment (female and male) minus the grand mean

disgust.definition: mean of the base condition means with emotion disgust (female and male) minus the grand mean

excitement.definition: mean of the base condition means with emotion excitement (female and male) minus the grand mean

fear.definition: mean of the base condition means with emotion fear (female and male) minus the grand mean

sad.definition: mean of the base condition means with emotion sad (female and male) minus the grand mean

Germany.definition: mean over the 16 gender x emotion personas of (Germany-extended condition mean minus matching base condition mean)

Nigeria.definition: mean over the 16 gender x emotion personas of (Nigeria-extended condition mean minus matching base condition mean)
